newsitem.title: CUBA: Air Jamaica starts regular flights to Cuba.
newsitem.headline: Air Jamaica starts regular flights to Cuba.

text.p: Air Jamaica inaugurated thrice-weekly flights between Montego Bay and Havana on Monday, reflecting recent moves by Cuba and Jamaica to strengthen their ties.

Official Cuban media said an Airbus-300 plane would fly Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays to Havana. Air Jamaica may extend its service in the future to flights between Montego Bay and the eastern city of Santago de Cuba, the news agency Prensa Latina said.

The Air Jamaica link was announced during a visit last month to Havana by Jamaican Prime Minister P.J. Patterson during which Cuba and Jamaica said they would seek greater economic and technological cooperation.
Bilateral trade between the two countries is minimal, but the Jamaican hotel chain Superclubs manages a hotel at Cuba's beach resort of Varadero east of Havana.
